 Print The latest promo of Bigg Boss 20 shows Mahhi Vij getting emotional after a conversation involving Love Gill’s mother’s message. Unhappy with how her actions are being presented on the show, the actress questions Bigg Boss and expresses her wish to leave the competition if things continue this way. She also makes it clear that the prize money is not important enough for her to stay. The promo begins with a message from Love Gill’s mother being played for the housemates. In Punjabi, she addresses Mahhi and questions her earlier remarks, reminding her that both women belong to the same age group. Since Mahhi is unable to understand the complete message, she asks Love to translate it for her. Watch Mahhi Vij Reacts To Jay Bhanushali’s Video With Daughter Tara Amid Divorce Rumours Love then explains, “Unhone ye baat boli ki agar Scout na hota to isko main nanga kar deti.” The exchange leaves Mahhi visibly disturbed. Expressing her disappointment, she says, “I’m just feeling ki mera hi sab dikha rahe hain mujhe lag raha hai. If this is the scene then I’ll not continue the show. Mujhe paise bhi nahi chahiye.” She then walks away from the conversation. The promo later shows Mahhi entering the washroom, where she struggles to control her emotions. Seeing her distressed, Arishfa Khan tries to comfort her and tells her, “Royo nahi, royo nahi.” However, Mahhi continues to feel overwhelmed and breaks down while addressing Bigg Boss. Questioning why she is being singled out, she says, “Why are you targeting me for everything? I also have a family outside who is watching.” She further expresses her concern about how her conduct is being shown to viewers. Pointing out that conversations about other contestants also take place behind their backs, Mahhi says, “I’m not here to spoil my name like this.” Towards the end of the promo, the actress is seen wiping away her tears and reiterating that she cannot continue under these circumstances. Whether she decides to leave the competition or changes her mind remains to be seen in the upcoming episode. Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more. Download the TOI app.
